# SeekerOG v0.1.0 Alpha

First pre-release of **SeekerOG**, a fork of [Seeker](https://github.com/jackBonadies/SeekerAndroid) (Soulseek client for Android) with advanced search, a Glass interface, a music library and an integrated player.

> Alpha: the Soulseek engine (Soulseek.NET) is unchanged, but the new UI and features have only been smoke-tested on an emulator. Please report problems in the repository issues.

## Install

| File | Devices |
|---|---|
| `SeekerOG-v0.1.0-alpha-arm64-v8a.apk` | Most phones from ~2017 onwards (64-bit ARM) |
| `SeekerOG-v0.1.0-alpha-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit ARM devices |

- Requires **Android 6.0 (API 23)** or newer. Target SDK 36.
- Package id `com.eibyx.seekerog`: installs **side by side** with the original Seeker (separate settings, login and data).
- Verify the download with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `VERIFY.txt` contains the `apksigner` / `aapt2` checks made by CI.

## Soulseek compatibility
- Same official Soulseek server, same accounts (username + password). No proxies, no extra accounts, no external services, no telemetry (FOSS flavour without Firebase/Crashlytics).
- Global, user and room searches, browsing shares, downloads, uploads, queues, rooms, private messages, user info, wishlist, ports/UPnP and auto-reconnect come from Seeker unchanged.
- The stored password is now encrypted with an Android Keystore AES-GCM key (migrated automatically from older plaintext storage).

## Search (inspired by Nicotine+)
- **Advanced syntax**, in the search box or the result filter:
  `formato:flac bits:24 frecuencia:96000 -live`, `artista:"Daft Punk" formato:flac`, `extension:mp3 bitrate:320 tamaño<100MB`, `dur:3:30~5`, `free:yes queue<=10 speed>=500kb`, `re:/\(19[89]\d\)/` … (English and Spanish keywords).
- Only words and `-exclusions` are sent to the server; everything else is filtered **locally**, as results arrive (non-matching results are dropped early to save memory).
- Formats (FLAC, MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, OGG, OPUS, ALAC, WMA, AIFF, DSD, ZIP, RAR, custom), lossless / lossy / Hi-Res, bitrate range, sample rate, bit depth, size, duration with tolerance, free slot, queue, upload speed, favourite users, already downloaded, user, folder, file name, exact phrases, partial words, regular expressions (length limit + match timeout).
- **Graphical filter builder**, saved **filter profiles**, **favourite searches**, **hide duplicate folders**, **CSV export** of results, syntax help.
- Metadata the peer did not send is treated as unknown and never invented.

## Glass interface
- New Glass light / dark / AMOLED themes (default), liquid gradient backgrounds, translucent cards, floating bottom bar **Home · Search · Transfers · Library · Settings** (Browse remains reachable from Home and user menus).
- New Home: prominent search, quick actions (browse, library, messages, rooms, users, filter profiles), live download summary, recent and favourite searches, favourite users, filter profiles.
- Appearance settings: accent colour, glass intensity, real background blur behind dialogs on Android 12+ (when the device enables it), animations, reduce visual effects, text size, reset.
- New launcher icon and app name.

## Library and player
- Library from Android's media index: songs, albums, artists, folders, playlists, favourites and SeekerOG downloads; files are played in place (never copied).
- Player: background playback (media foreground service), notification / lock-screen / Bluetooth / headset controls, audio focus, pause when headphones are unplugged, queue, shuffle, repeat, album art, real file quality (codec, bitrate, sample rate, bit depth, channels), output route (speaker, wired, Bluetooth, USB DAC), system equalizer.
- Formats: whatever the device's Android decoders support (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC/M4A, OGG, Opus; ALAC on devices that support it). Bit-perfect output is **not** claimed.

## Known limitations
- Not yet tested on physical devices or with a live Soulseek login in this release cycle (emulator smoke test only: start-up, navigation, library, FLAC/MP3/WAV playback).
- Grouping results by user and multi-select of search results are not implemented yet (results are already grouped by folder).
- `artist:` / `album:` match folder and file names: Soulseek search results contain no tags.
- Transfer pause / priority controls are only those Seeker already supported.
- Most new strings are translated to English and Spanish only.

## Credits and licences
SeekerOG is based on Seeker by Jack Bonadies, uses Soulseek.NET by JP Dillingham and Mono.Nat. Licences are kept in the repository (GPL-3.0 for Seeker). Ideas for search filters come from Nicotine+ (no code copied).
